title: FancyZones not restoring windows when I switch virtual desktops

judgment.rationale: The linked #24473 addresses the same RDP reconnect, desktop switch, and FancyZones zone-restoration failure. Keep one investigation rather than proposing a second implementation; no shipped fix is claimed.
evidence: The report says an RDP disconnect changes the effective display size and that switching desktops after reconnect leaves windows outside their zones.
The issue links #24473, “After reconnecting to a session, windows on my 2nd desktop are not being restored to their zones when I press Win-RightArrow to switch desktops.”
judgment.recommended_action: Track any continuing reproduction under #24473 and do not duplicate code work.

fix_assessment.rationale: The existing linked report already describes the same failure sequence. The evidence supports duplicate triage, not a claim that a fix has shipped.

issue_context.summary: The FancyZones virtual-desktop symptom matches the linked report about RDP reconnects leaving windows on another desktop out of their zones.
issue_context.known_information: This issue reports RDP disconnect/reconnect changing display dimensions and FancyZones not restoring zones on another virtual desktop.
issue_context.inferences: The exact symptom may be the same as #24473, whose title describes RDP reconnect followed by switching desktops and missing FancyZones restoration.
issue_context.analysis: The issue timeline links #24473 with an almost identical scenario and outcome. This supports consolidating investigation, but does not establish that either issue is fixed.
issue_context.initial_investigation: Compared the complete report with its linked issue #24473 title and scenario; no separate linked fix is present in this snapshot.
